what: A Windows-first, multi-output Player architecture: a claimed box with durable physical output slots, one cloud-facing Supervisor, and isolated Display Runtimes that keep verified local content on screen.
position: Architecture agreed and planned; implementation is blocked until the proposed design authority is promoted to docs/design/approved/box-player/.
next: Owner promotion of the design authority, then M1 only. Linux is a follow-on feature after Windows architecture, six-output acceptance, resilience, and safe-update milestones prove the shared model.
label: workstream:box-player
